name: 田村纹理特征
description: 提取 perceptual texture 特征 (coarseness, 对比度, directionality) 以识别 unnatural texture characteristics typical of AI生成的 images.
mechanism: Computes Tamura coarseness 通过分析 local average differences at multiple scales, and directionality by computing 梯度 orientation 直方图s. AI images tend to have lower coarseness and more isotropic 梯度 分布s.
parameters: Scales: 5 levels (2^1 to 2^5), Gradient: Sobel operator, Orientation bins: 16
accuracy: 中等 — 65-78%，作为补充纹理信号最佳
source: Tamura, H. et al. (1978) — Textural Features Corresponding to Visual Perception, IEEE SMC
useCase: Detecting unnatural texture properties in AI生成的 surfaces and materials

references.title: Tamura, H. et al. (1978). Textural Features Corresponding to Visual Perception. IEEE SMC.

strengths:
• Perceptually meaningful 特征
• Captures texture at multiple scales
• Independent of image content
• Fast computation
limitations:
• Lower standalone 准确度
• Sensitive to image 分辨率
• May overlap with other texture methods
• AI improving at texture generation
